name: asuswrt
description: Inspect and control an ASUS (AsusWRT) router from Claude Code — clients, WAN, firewall state, port forwarding, guest WiFi, WiFi security. Ships a skill and an MCP server. Requires the asuswrt program: install it first with `uv tool install "git+https://github.com/gittycat/asuswrt-tools" --with mcp`, otherwise the MCP server has no `asuswrt-mcp` command to start.
